text: The Internet and new media is an interdisciplinary field that integrates communication studies, information technology, content creation and digital marketing, focusing on the operational rules of emerging media forms such as the Internet, mobile terminals and social media. It breaks the boundaries of traditional media and studies "how to produce, disseminate and operate content in the digital environment", solving the problems of communication efficiency, user connection and commercial conversion in the era of fragmented information. From short video planning to new media account operation, from data-driven content optimization to the construction of metaverse scenarios, this major covers the entire chain of digital communication.
